description: Figure 1, titled "The similarity of HSAs in different languages across all layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B," is a line plot that illustrates the cosine similarity between the Hidden States of selected tokens (HSAs) for different language pairs across the layers of the Qwen1.5-1.8B model. The x-axis represents the model's layers, ranging from 0 to 21, with each integer value labeled. The y-axis represents the similarity score, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot displays four distinct lines, each representing a language pair: en&en (English-English), en&es (English-Spanish), en&bn (English-Bengali), and bn&hi (Bengali-Hindi). The line for en&en is colored red and shows a high similarity score that remains relatively stable across the layers, starting at approximately 0.95 and ending at about 0.94. The other three lines, en&es (blue), en&bn (green), and bn&hi (orange), all exhibit a similar pattern: they start at a lower similarity of around 0.55, rise to a peak of approximately 0.85 in the middle layers (around layer 10-12), and then decline to a value of about 0.65 at the final layers.
